'''CZ-13''', also known as '''Cees''', was a friendly and efficient [[Secretary droid/Legends|receptionist droid]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the conflict the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked for [[IsoTech]], a front-company for the black-market tech-salavaging operations of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] siblings [[Reom]] and [[Shira (Twi'lek)|Shira]]. CZ-13 served as the receptionist at the company's offices on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="BTR" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
CZ-13 was present when a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] hired by Reom to search for the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], a lost [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] belonging to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the spacers arrived at the offices, CZ-13 greeted them and then locked the doors behind them before verifying their identities. Explaining that the doors were locked due to increased security caused by recent events, meaning fears the rivals would try and steal information concerning the ''Sa Nalaor'', CZ-13 then guided the group to Reom's office.<ref name="BTR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
CZ-13 first appeared in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] in [[2013]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
